reviews.author: L'Ericole Real
reviews.text:
I went there because I heard there was a Gyukatsu restaurant in Daehakro. I heard that Gyukatsu is a food from the Kansai region of Japan. Kansai is located in the center of Japan, home to cities such as Osaka and Kyoto. It is said that people in this area ate a lot of fried beef. Namu Wiki states that it developed into the current Gyukatsu. Here, ‘gyu’ is the Japanese word for cow. It is said that this dish began to spread throughout Japan around the 1980s. But I've never had gyukatsu before. When I found out that there was a food called Gyukatsu, I was shocked to learn that all the pork cutlets I had eaten so far were made with pork. Ignorantly, until then, I thought that sirloin cutlets and other foods were made from beef. Because it was expensive. This realization naturally led to the question, what does Gyukatsu taste like?

Furato Restaurant Hyehwa, which specializes in making Gyukatsu, is located behind Marronnier Park. You will come out around the corner after passing through an alley where people are lined up to see the play. It's a surprisingly quiet place. The restaurant is located on the second floor of a quiet building. The interior is quite spacious. There is a Japanese-style painting hanging on one side. It smells strongly of Japan. However, the staff do not loudly greet you in Japanese. Just say “Welcome” in Korean.

I sat down and ordered ‘Furato Gyukatsu’ and ‘Steak Set Meal’. The food came out not long after. The quantity was quite large. A 'stone plate' with solid fuel was also produced. They said that Gyukatsu should not be eaten raw. I placed the gyukatsu on a stone plate. I also uploaded steak. I was told it would take about 2-3 minutes for one piece to cook. I waited. Saliva gathered in my mouth and I swallowed it. I felt like someone sitting next to me could hear me swallowing. The person next to me said. “Hold on!”

After about 3 minutes, I picked up my chopsticks. The red side of the meat was not visible. No one said anything, so I dipped it in the thin sauce and put it in my mouth. Then the person next to me spoke. “You have to put salt first!” I didn't respond. Instead, I focused on the gyukatsu in my mouth. oh! It tasted amazing. The outside was crispy like shrimp cracker. But the inside was soft. The meat went down my throat and disappeared before I could chew it completely. Oh no! In just 3 seconds, I picked up my chopsticks and picked up another piece of Gyukatsu. This time I only added salt. ah! This is delicious! The batter crumbles under the pressure of your teeth while the lean, soft meat chews. I thought that if there was Gyukatsu-flavored gum, I could chew it all day. Steak was a bit boring compared to this. Because it didn't taste crunchy. Still, it was good. I felt rich.

The owner of Furato Restaurant Hyehwa Branch is a handsome man. He is also a poet. He was so delicate that he even lifted the tongs and flipped the gyukatsu himself. he asked. “How do you feel? Is it delicious?” I answered like this: “Ah, boss, this is my first time eating food like this. Would combining cotton candy and gum make something like this? Please give me more meat. It keeps disappearing.” The boss laughed. The person next to me also laughed. It was a happy evening.

A new concept hot pot restaurant that operates like conveyor belt sushi! It was so amazing and fun to see a cute train robot serving food.

Unlimited refills of over 100 ingredients for 21,900 won on weekday dinners (18,900 won for lunch)! It's a one-pot-per-person system, so you can choose the broth you want and enjoy it to your liking.

The best thing is that you can eat comfortably at your seat without having to wait in line at the self-service bar.

I started with Mala Hongtang, and I made a special sesame sauce to dip it in, so it was a fantastic combination!

From premium meat to fresh vegetables, seafood, Vietnamese spring rolls, chicken nuggets, and kkoobaro... there was so much variety that I could never get tired of it.

Another great tip is that it’s open until 3 a.m. so you can visit even late at night!

It seemed like the friend I was eating with had the same thought as me. A rich and deep broth flavor
The taste of peanut butter was different from what I expected, so I didn't eat it anymore.

2. Kwabarou is... um...
Aside from the fact that the batter is so thick that you can't really taste the meat... the sauce is...
It smells too much like vinegar... and that's just...
I didn't eat it anymore... moderately sour and sweet.
The vinegar scent from the beginning, not the sauce, is unpleasant to the nose.
It was that much.

Taste is subjective, so just use it as a reference.
Because it has good reviews, there are people like me who will visit it.
I think there are people who feel the same way as me and I think it's worth visiting.

reviews.author: Jo Hye-jeong

reviews.author: sesame seed

It was a bit disappointing that there was no lotus root in the ingredients section, but the ingredients were kept fresh and clean. The staff are also friendly. You don't have to clean up your dishes before leaving. It's okay to eat occasionally.

reviews.author: Lᄀ (polar bear diving)
reviews.text:

reviews.author: Nayoung Song
reviews.text: The jjamppong is pretty good, but the soybean paste is really delicious. Menbosha is also delicious. I decided to go eat soybean paste again next time.   Recognized as a Ginjjajang restaurant.

reviews.author: Dayoung Kim

reviews.author: Jiyoung Oh
reviews.text: It was my first time eating Dolban Jjajang and it was very delicious! It was my first time eating Dongpo pork, and it was very tender, easily torn apart, and delicious. 😊 After eating, dessert was served, and I ate it just to satisfy my appetite :)

reviews.author: Eugene
reviews.text:
I came here because a friend who lives in Hyehwa told me that it was a good restaurant in Hyehwa.
Great taste... . It's a good restaurant in Daehakro. It's so delicious. Menbosha is not oily and full of shrimp, so the dongpo meat is so soft and delicious. reviews.author: Jojo
reviews.text:
Baek Jong-won Chinese Food Bar Lichun Market Daehakro CGV branch located near Exit 4 of Hyehwa Station
As expected from Baek Jong-won's store, it is good value for money. The store wasn't very spacious, but I sat outside at the entrance.

reviews.author: Steven Kim
reviews.text: The food turnover rate and cooking speed are very fast. The mala xianggu and menbo sha I had before were really delicious, but the mapo tofu I ordered this time tasted too plain, and the fried rice had an overly strong spicy flavor so I didn't like it.

reviews.author: Junsu Park
reviews.text: Every time I go to this chain restaurant, I can't tell because the taste is different each time I go. It's difficult to have uniform taste in chain restaurants.

reviews.author: Kim Gwang-kwon
reviews.text: The quantity is a bit small as the price is cheap, but it is delicious.

reviews.author: Kai Lee
reviews.text:
Hyehwa Chinese Bar
Baek Jong-won franchise's strength is its low price, armed with unique efficiency.
It's great to experience a wide spectrum of flavors at a low price.

address: 1st floor, 64 Daehakro 12-gil, Jongno-gu, Seoul, South Korea

reviews.author: Mj Park
reviews.text:
Good value for money and good food quality, recommended
Japchae rice served with a glass of beer and wrapped in flower bread was a fantastic combination.
I was impressed by the refreshing and deep flavor of the Kodari Naengjjamppong soup! As expected, I thought famous houses were different.

It was also nice that each table was spaced wide apart so you could eat privately.
The staff were friendly and overall it was a pleasant meal.
Next time, I want to come with my family or friends and try the multi-course meal.

reviews.author: Heodong
reviews.text: Above all, I was more impressed by the overall taste of the food, which was not greasy and could be eaten cleanly until the end. I was satisfied enough to want to try other menu items next time. Next time, I plan to try high-end menu items like Samseon Jjamppong and Yusanseul. If you like Chinese food, I recommend stopping by at least once. If you are looking for good Chinese food in Hyehwa, ‘Seoraehyang Daehakro Branch’ may be the answer.

reviews.author: Yein Lee
reviews.text:
#Sponsorship I went to Seoraehyang, a Chinese restaurant in Daehakro!
The sirloin sweet and sour pork (33,000) was impressive because the meat was thick and crispy... The sauce is sweet and sour, so it's not overpowering, so I keep using it. The meat quality is too coarse..! I was impressed by the taste of the Chadol Jjamppong (16,000) because the soup was thick and had a lot of meat in it.
Jjajangmyeon (8,000) tastes faithful to the basics!
Overall, it's clean and high-quality Chinese food, so it's a great place to go on a date or take your parents. I 100% plan to visit again!

reviews.author: To Jang Ja-yeon
reviews.text: I went to Hyehwa Station Chinese restaurant Seoraehyang Daehakro branch with an acquaintance. I ordered the new summer menu, Kodari Shin Naengjjamppong, because I heard it was delicious. I even enjoyed razji, a chicken dish with spicy peppercorns, and draft lager beer. I chose menu items I had never tried before and was very satisfied. In particular, I would like to recommend that you try the new menu as it is a great combination of cool broth and spicy kodari sashimi. Rajji is a taste that anyone who likes malatang will like. This place even has a large room, so it would be a good place for company dinners or anniversaries. There is no other way to heal if you watch a performance such as a play or musical and have a refreshing meal here. Go to Daehakro and enjoy romance, recharge your youthful energy, and enjoy delicious food.

reviews.author: Poche
reviews.text: The sweet and sour pork is so fresh, crispy, and delicious! The oil is clean, so the fried food is clean and there is no meaty smell. It was the best sirloin sweet and sour pork ever🥰 The cold jjamppong, which is great to eat in hot summer days like these, has all three flavors: sweet, sour, and spicy haha. Stop by Seoraehyang while watching a play and eating in Daehakro~!

reviews.author: Hwang Eun-seon
reviews.text:
I visited here before on the recommendation of a friend who works near Gwanghwamun, and it was so delicious that I brought my boyfriend back haha.
This is a restaurant you must stop by when you come to Gwanghwamun because it is a taste that you have never tried anywhere else.
First of all, the beef dosakmyeon noodles were really chewy and had a good texture, and the broth was a work of art…
It's savory and refreshing, with a subtle scent of spices, so I guess it's a taste that all Koreans will like??
And the fried rice and dim sum here are delicious, so I just come back every time I come to Gwanghwamun.

reviews.author: jin
reviews.text:
I used it packaged! Every single menu item was delicious. The quantity is also generous~~
I recommend tiger rice bowl, shrimp fried rice, and fish sauce rice bowl!!!

reviews.author: Yunana
reviews.text:
A great restaurant in Gwanghwamun for eating alone!
It's even more delicious because you can taste the authentic Chinese cuisine, prepared by a local chef who specializes in Chinese food.

reviews.author: Lina
reviews.text: I ordered Kkanpunggi and Shomai. The Kkanpunggi is an easy-to-eat size, crispy and thinly fried, moist on the inside, and slightly spicy! It's hot so eat with caution. Shomai is moist and delicious when eaten with soy sauce and ginger.

reviews.author: Juu
reviews.text: I ate it packaged and it was delicious!

reviews.author: Hb K
reviews.text: After visiting Cheonghwawon in Daehakro once, I remembered it so much that I visited it again. It was close to Hyehwa Station, so it was easily accessible, and there was a steaming dim sum steamer inside the store, giving me a subtle local atmosphere. The beef noodle soup had a deep yet light taste that was impressive, and my friend who went with me to study abroad in Taiwan also admitted that it had a local feel. The Fish-Hyang Eggplant Rice Bowl had a good balance of umami, and the Shomai and Mapo Tofu were also faithful to the basics, making it an overall satisfying meal.

reviews.author: Lee Haneul
reviews.text: I visited because it reminded me of the beef noodle soup I had when I traveled to Taiwan. The aroma gives off a distinctly local feel, and the soup is spicy and really delicious. The noodles are special and fresh! The dough is really chewy, so the texture of the noodles is really good. Next time, I’ll try dim sum and other foods!

reviews.author: Kim Hee-seo
reviews.text: There were a lot of customers during weekend lunch. Customers kept coming! And since it's the only beef dosakmyeon restaurant in Daehakro, I think it's a good place to come for a special meal. They say the locals cook it themselves. I especially recommend the dim sum because it is chewy and delicious!

reviews.author: 0802 Yuha
reviews.text:
I felt trustworthy because the inside of the store was clean and I could see dim sum being steamed in person. The beef dosakmyeon had a rich and deep broth made with beef bones and meat, so I could clearly feel the charm of authentic Taiwanese beef noodle, and I really liked the unique chewy texture of the dosakmyeon.

I was satisfied with the Sujeongdal Dumplings because the combination of plump shrimp meat and chives was clean and light, and the cream shrimp had a crunchy batter and a savory sauce that went well together, making it a taste I kept coming back to.

It's the perfect place to eat in Daehakro because it's good to share a variety of menu items.

reviews.author: saerom shim
reviews.text:
This is a place where you can enjoy Taiwanese beef noodles and dim sum near Hyehwa Station.
The beef cut noodles were chewy with a rich beef bone base and were highly satisfactory for the price, while the shomai had a rich texture with the combination of shrimp, pork, and flying fish roe.
Kwabarou is fried with potato starch and is crispy on the outside and moist on the inside, making it a must-eat dish at this house.
Sholongpo also has a clean, juicy meat and is not overly spicy, so the overall meal combination is balanced.
There are a variety of seats, so it's perfect for a meal or date before or after a performance.
If you are looking for clean Chinese food in Hyehwa and Daehakro, this is a recommended place.

reviews.author: Professor Pig
reviews.text:
Daehakro Restaurant Malliseong!!
Eohyang Dongo, Samseon Fried Rice, and Chadol Jjamppong Rice were all of great quality.
I was happy because it was plentiful and delicious.
The store was very spacious and had rooms so it looked good for gatherings.
The owner is also very kind.

reviews.author: BRIANNA “Sophie” Sopi
reviews.text: I had chadol jjamppong rice at the Chinese restaurant in Daehakro that appeared in Master of Living, and the jjamppong had a bad smell. The quantity arrived at the price, and there was a lot. However, it seems to have a greasy taste so there are people who like it and dislike it. The service was quick and friendly.

reviews.author: YO LEE
reviews.text: This is an authentic Chinese restaurant located in an alley inside Marronnier Park in Daehakro. The interior is a bit old, and the seats are close together, giving it a hectic atmosphere. The interior is not as spacious as expected, but there are separate rooms. It's been a while since I ordered udon, and I was a bit surprised that it tasted better than I expected. It's not easy for udon to be particularly delicious, but the visuals are amazing. There's a large piece of octopus in it, and the broth is very rich. I didn't have time to try the other dishes, but I think I'll have to try the dishes the next time I visit.

reviews.author: Gwangjufoodie
reviews.text: Today, I thoroughly enjoyed four menu items at Gyhyangak, including cold cucumber salad, razji, sesame tangmyeon, and jeunggyo. The cold cucumber salad is refreshing and opens up your taste buds, and the spiciness on the outside and inside of the lazuli is so addictive. The spicy and deep flavor of the spicy noodle soup was attractive, and the Jeunggyo was a nice light ending to the meal. This is a restaurant I would like to visit again because the taste of the entire menu is well balanced. The atmosphere is comfortable, so I recommend it for both dates and gatherings!!

reviews.author: Lee- Action girl
reviews.text:
Visiting such a classy restaurant as an ordinary person seems like the border between adventure and experience. Haha

reviews.author: Woosik Kim
reviews.text: Each dish has touches that cannot be found in Korean-style Chinese restaurants. I can't help but feel that the quantity is smaller than the price. Even though he is a celebrity, the owner chef holding the wok in the kitchen is impressive.

reviews.author: Winnie Lee
reviews.text:
The interior is very small, but there is still a table for one person, so it's good for eating alone.
The three-color sujebi is delicious.
This time I ordered bean noodles, and it comes with sugar and salt so you can adjust it to suit your taste.
The kimchi that comes with the bean noodles is refreshing and delicious.
The noodles come in somen type.
Since the noodles sold here are banquet noodles and mixed noodles, it seems that the noodles used here are also used for bean noodles.
I enjoyed the black bean soup as it was neither too thick nor too watery, just the right amount of richness.

reviews.author: cartoon
reviews.text:
It's amazing that a small store like this still exists. You can cook a variety of noodles deliciously.
I don't like the food, but the space is so small that I go in the winter.
Clothes can't get in the way that much.

reviews.author: Daehong Kim
reviews.text:
The group I went with ordered clam kalguksu, mixed noodles, radish noodles, and rice balls. The clam kalguksu was in very good condition. I was a little worried after reading a review that said the seaweed wasn't done well, but the kalguksu I tasted that day was perfectly seared.
The taste of the soup was refreshing and refreshing. I felt like it was flavored with broth from clams. I ate it without leaving a single drop of soup.
The group looking for something refreshing also ate a whole bowl of radish noodles. The evaluation was that it was of a high standard.
Everyone gave a thumbs up after trying the bibim noodles, which had different tastes depending on the restaurant. Even though I don't enjoy bibim noodles, I had no choice but to agree after tasting it. The sour, spicy, and sweet flavors were all in perfect harmony and none of them stood out. The first, middle, and final tastes were all pleasant.
The rice balls, which I was worried about, were also seasoned well and I enjoyed them until the end.
Next time I come, I would like to try another menu I haven't tried before.
As it was lunch time, the place was full, and people could be seen discussing the play performance. It seemed like a delicious restaurant frequented by performers. At one time, when the Daehakro theater scene was doing well, it was said to be so popular that it signed meal contracts with 13 theater companies. It opened in 2004.

reviews.author: Sohe Hong Seong-woo
reviews.text:
A noodle restaurant with plenty of value for the price.

For my taste, the noodles feel a bit spread out.
Recommended for those who like shabby old style.

reviews.author: Details
reviews.text: It's very delicious for the price. I definitely recommend one spicy one. It was cold and I was rubbing my hands while walking around Daehakro, and it occurred to me that I came across it. As expected, the taste has not changed and is still delicious.

The salmon rice bowl is topped with plump, oily salmon, and the fried dumplings are crunchy and delicious.

Dumplings have a strong vegetable taste, so they may be unfamiliar to people accustomed to traditional dumplings.

Grilled gyoza restaurant^^*

reviews.author: ssoongo
reviews.text:
Hyehwa Kalguksu, visited after a long time
After a very long time, the parking lot right in front was gone and a large building was built.
Since it has been famous as a good restaurant for a long time, it is natural for it to make this much money. The price has gone up, but the taste and quantity that matches the price remain the same.
Nevertheless, kalguksu is now 12,000 won, so it has gone up a lot. I am full from just one bowl of kalguksu.

reviews.author: SEUNGWOO SEO
reviews.text: 30 years ago, 10 years ago, even now... This is a great noodle restaurant in Hyehwa-dong. I ordered boiled pork, fried fish, mung bean pancake, and noodles. The boiled pork was well cooked. Although the softness of each part was different - some parts were a bit tough - it was delicious. Mung bean sprouts. Revisit after 7 years.
Meanwhile, the restaurant has been remodeled and is clean.
Fried fish is still delicious.
When two people visit, I recommend 1 soup and fried fish.

reviews.author: AO
reviews.text:
My parents' restaurant became my restaurant. A place that still has the same old taste. What has changed is that the proportion of young customers seems to have increased.

It is the taste of Andong Guksi style Guksi. The taste of kimchi is also very good with clean aged kimchi.

reviews.author: Gayoung Kim
reviews.text: It's an old store, but I liked the clean interior and bathroom. Guksi feels like a mid-noodle, somewhere between kalguksu and noodles. The garnish is simple, but the soup is lightly sprinkled with pepper, so the soup has a rich taste. Even if you add a generous spoonful of red dadaegi, it is not too spicy, so it is good because it does not spoil the taste of the soup. The fried fish is similar to the large-sized dongtaejeon eaten on holidays, but the batter is crispy and seasoned lightly, so it was delicious even without soy sauce.

reviews.author: Son Hoyoung
reviews.text: A Chinese restaurant that has been located in Hyehwa Rotary for a long time. I entered this house as if I was suddenly craving Jjajang (black bean paste). Ganjjajang order completed. It's soy sauce topped with a fried egg. Break the fragrant yolk and eat it with jjajang. When you eat noodles for the first time, your eyes widen at the chewiness. The crunch of the onions is also good. Every time I chew, I hear a pleasant crunching sound in my ears. Although it doesn't contain a lot, the shrimp meat is fresh when I chew it. I think the seasoning is a little too strong for me, but it has a strong, familiar taste. I think this is the way to go. I ate all the noodles and even the onion sauce. If Jjajang is this good, I'm curious about other dishes from this house as well.

reviews.author: Winnie Lee
reviews.text:
It's a small Chinese restaurant so it feels a bit crowded.
I ordered Yuringi and Samseon Jjajang, but the amount of Yuringi was very small compared to the price.
The taste was mild and not irritating. I ordered a small portion of Samseon Jjajang and the portion was quite large.
It is not too sweet and has a light taste.
All food tastes were satisfactory.

reviews.author: Jaewan Jo
reviews.text: What does an old restaurant mean? I also thought about whether it was simply that it had endured for a long time or if there was something special about it.

reviews.author: Andrew Kim
reviews.text:
After the Hyehwa-dong JCC (Talent Culture Center) album release concert, the team members went to 'Geummun', a traditional Chinese restaurant with over 80 years of operation since 1940, located in Hyehwa-dong Rotary for dinner and an after-party.

'Kummen' is not very spacious, but it is a 3-story building, so it has some spacious rooms, so it is a good place for a company dinner.. On this day, we made a reservation on the same day, so we were seated at several tables.

Although it is an old place that is over 80 years old, it is well maintained, so you can naturally feel its age, but it does not have a very old-fashioned feel, and it feels like it has been well maintained.

At the table I was sitting at, we ordered soybean paste, noodles, and fried eggplant. Each dish we ordered didn't have flashy plating or decorations, but there wasn't too much seasoning, so we enjoyed it. In particular, the fried egg on top of the soybean paste had the yolk intact and the white slightly fried, reminding me of the jajangmyeon I used to eat at a local Chinese restaurant when I was young.

I recommend coming here when you come to Daehakro for a performance or on a date and want to eat Chinese food with a slightly old-fashioned feel.

reviews.author: Dawnman Lee
reviews.text:
Geummun, a Chinese restaurant with a long history.

Guided by memories of attending a nearby high school more than 20 years ago, I came to Jjajangmyeon to eat sweet and sour pork.
It was a popular restaurant back in the day and is still in business. It was a long-established store back then, and it is still the same now.

The quality of the food leaves something to be desired, but overall it feels like they made it with good ingredients.

The sweet and sour pork tasted just like when I was in high school, so it gave me a special feeling. While all the local Chinese restaurants made sweet and sour pork with ketchup sauce, this restaurant stir-fried it with a luxurious, slightly golden sauce. Jjajang Jjamppong is also quite good.

Goryangju went really well with the lamb skin and the seafood nurungji stew was great. Above all, I really liked the sweet and sour pork because it had the same taste as I remembered.

A restaurant specializing in Chinese food

Samseon Jjajang costs 12,000 won.

Stamina Jjajangmyeon!
This is Ganjjajang for meat lovers.
Plenty of toppings with chunks of meat that look like they've been stir-fried over high heat!
Visually, it's disgusting.
Meat mixed with black bean sauce cannot be tasteless.
However, meat with a lot of fat is slightly repulsive.
Not only meat but also three fried shrimp are on top.
A fried Chinese-style fried egg is also a topping!
If I eat all of this, I think I'll have a week's worth of stamina.
Ganjjajang (ganjjajang) is thick and oily and tastes good.
It has a slightly sweet taste, so it tastes great!
The visuals are good, the cost-effectiveness is not bad, and the taste is good.
Since all of this comes into your mouth at once, it is a bit burdensome to finish eating.
If it comes with Jjamppong soup, it would cover up the greasiness!
Still, I was able to cover up the greasiness to some extent by giving pickled radish and pickled cabbage as side dishes.
However, Jjajangmyeon is a bit burdensome to eat every day.

Store & Tips & Review
The store is small and has seating for 2 and 4 people, as well as counter seating, making it a good place to eat alone.
Order and pay through the kiosk at the entrance.
This is a method of paying for menu items in advance even when waiting.
Break time is from 2:30 to 4:30.
I arrived around 2:15 and break time had already started.
If possible, I recommend visiting before 2 o'clock.
There are only three menu items: Jjajang, Jjamppong, and Menbosha.
I understand the different price ranges, but it is somewhat disappointing that a bowl of rice is 2,000 won.
Surprisingly, there were quite a few elderly guests over 60 years old.
For them, it is Jjajangmyeon that brings back the taste of memories.
You wear sanitary gloves when cooking.
If possible, it may be better to use cooking utensils.
I visited after seeing it on social media, but fortunately it wasn't a failure.

Emoy Daehakro Branchㅡ

reviews.text:
Nirosa Restaurant is located on the way to Naksan Park along the main road of Marronnier Park after coming out of Exit 2 of Hyehwa Station. Pitjeriao is across the street, so it was easy to find.

We had set menu B.
I ordered a set menu that included salad + 2 curries + 2 naans (plain naan, butter naan) + 1 bowl of rice + chicken tikka + 2 drinks.

There were two curries to choose from, so I went with seafood curry and Palak chicken with cheese and spinach chicken. As for naan, plain naan and butter naan are provided as standard, but I wanted to try garlic naan, so I ordered it.
The rice was changed to Southeast Asian style jasmine rice.
I had a choice of two drinks, so I chose Mango Lassi and Strawberry Lassi.

Compared to other places, Daehakro is a youthful street, so the prices are reasonable and it has an Indian atmosphere, making you feel like you are traveling to India. A Nepalese person runs a restaurant in Daehakro, so the atmosphere feels even more local.

Nirosa Restaurant
43 Dongsung-gil, Jongno-gu, Seoul

reviews.author: Kaz Kurogawa
reviews.text:
From lovers' seats to group gatherings such as anniversaries, birthdays, and company dinners, this is a place with the best atmosphere. I trusted this store because it was one of the best stores in Daehakro with 19 years of tradition.
There are so many types of alcohol. There are over 100 kinds of alcohol to choose from, including wine, craft beer, highball, and whiskey, so it was fun to choose from. The quality of the food exceeded expectations, and the prices were reasonable, so I was satisfied. The spacing between tables is wide, so even a group gathering of 120 people won't feel stuffy at all, and there is also a private room that can accommodate up to 10 people, making it perfect for important meetings or birthday parties.
There are many menu items that pair well with alcohol, including natural cheese platters, gambas, jamon, fondue & sausage, and burrata salad. Be sure to try the pizza made with 99.5% natural cheese. It's really delicious.
Celebrities and theater actors often come here, so if you're lucky, it's fun to be in the same space. There was a free instant camera in the store, so it was great for taking pictures with friends. Perhaps that's why I understand why there are so many gatherings of large corporations, financial institutions, medical circles, government offices, and arts groups. The music selection is very atmospheric and sensible, so I think it brings out more emotions.
It felt even more special because it was not a common store that can be found anywhere, but a unique space found only in Hyehwa and Daehakro. I really recommend it for dates, birthdays, and important occasions, and personally, I think the atmosphere becomes more lively if you go on a snowy or rainy day.

I had to walk a bit from Seoul National University Hospital.
It is located on the 2nd floor and has an elevator.
It opens at 11:20, but I arrived around 11:30 and was the first customer.
I sat by the window and ate while looking outside.
I ordered Lakota cheese salad, fan steak, and rose pasta.
The salad sauce was a bit strong, but the Lakota cheese was fresh...the fan meat was a little tough due to the veins in the middle. The rose pasta was a little spicy. I don't think it's good value for money, but it was a good meal.
A repeat visit is so so.

reviews.author: Pathfinder
reviews.text: You can use the elevator and the external stairs. The hall is very spacious and the spacing between tables is good. The food is also average. However, the tables and chairs are a bit sticky. If you order a set for 3 people, it may not be enough for 3 adults.

reviews.author: Jojo
reviews.text:
The Kitchen 750, a Hyehwa Station pasta restaurant located near Exit 1 of Hyehwa Station. Clean store and restrooms. Close to 20 tables available for group guests. You can taste wood-fired pizza and, above all, good value for money. The portion is large and the taste is good. Rose pasta full of seafood and very delicious homemade 750 ricotta salad
Daehakro Date Restaurant

reviews.author: Kyeong Hee Moon
reviews.text:
The food was delicious, but the salad wasn't very good.
The water bottle given in advance had red pepper powder on it...
This was my second visit following last summer, and I was very disappointed with the cleanliness and freshness of the ingredients.

reviews.author: Eunah Jew
reviews.text:
I had rose pasta and margherita pizza. The rose pasta (serves 2) was generous and kept warm until the end, which was nice. The taste was unexpected, but it had a sour and light taste of tomatoes mixed with Greek yogurt and wheat flour starch, and was slightly spicy. Thanks to you, I ate it without feeling greasy. Margherita pizza is a thin pizza and seasoned well. The cheese topping was also chewy. It feels like eating tortilla pizza. It was disappointing that there was too little basil on top. The hygiene was a bit disappointing, but the taste was good so I would go again.
The other day I had Shrimp Aglio Olio Pasta, and honestly, I don't like it. Contains 2 medium-sized shrimp and 4 fingernail-sized shrimp. The amount of noodles is not too generous, but just enough to avoid the shortage. The seasoning is full of spices, but I think it would be better to reduce it and add a little more flavor. The balance was bad. If you smell it closely, it smells like a musty seafood smell, so be careful if you're not used to it. Neither the taste nor the quantity was what I expected from pasta priced at 15,900.
Ordering and payment must be done in person at the table. The advantage is that the store is spacious and has large windows.

address: 2nd floor, 24 Daehakro 10-gil, Ihwa-dong, Jongno-gu, Seoul, South Korea

reviews.author: Philosophizing
reviews.text:
Rolling Pasta located near Hyehwa!!
No matter when you visit, you can enjoy delicious and savory pasta at a reasonable price. I recommend eating here haha.

reviews.author: SHIN PD Shin PD (Shin PD)
reviews.text:
A cost-effective restaurant that I sometimes stop by when I feel like pasta.
A great place to order a set meal with friends.

reviews.author: ancient law
reviews.text:
Baek Jong-won’s famous restaurant near the center of Daehakro
I didn't see the rooftop cat, but I visited after watching a play nearby.
The seats are very spacious and ordering can be done conveniently through a kiosk.
Pasta and risotto were cheap and very delicious.
There were so many different types of pasta that I had to worry about choosing what to eat.
It closed at 9 o'clock, so I wouldn't have been able to eat if I was a little late, but fortunately I arrived on time.

reviews.author: one
reviews.text: 3 people, 3 pasta dishes, beef pork belly rice?? I ordered a salad like this. Everything tasted delicious!! The cost-effectiveness is very good and the taste is perfect~

reviews.author: BRIANNA “Sophie” Sopi
reviews.text: Baek Jong-won brand rolling pasta, the inside of the store was clean, I ordered one of the representative menu items and added some spicy food to it, but it was greasy and not good for my taste. If there were no pickles, I wouldn't have been able to finish it. Seeing that other tables ate it all, I thought I had ordered the spicy pasta by mistake. It was spicy, but not as spicy as the name suggests.

address: 2nd floor, 141 Daehak-ro, Jongno-gu, Seoul, South Korea

reviews.author: Shin Min-seo
reviews.text: The atmosphere is nice and the Kaymak pizza is delicious!!

reviews.author: Chilpa
reviews.text:
It was raining because it was in front of the station, so I went somewhere and it was a complete success.
The pepperoni pizza is salty and spicy, but the pepperoni tastes truly American.
The mushroom cream pasta had a truffle flavor and was full of mushrooms, so it was delicious.
The orangeade was so delicious that I asked if they sold pickles separately.
If I come to Hyehwa, I will definitely come here.

reviews.author: kang mark
reviews.text:
I found this restaurant by chance at Hyehwa Station. It’s really close to exit 4.

What impressed me the most here was that they had a variety of fusion menus, including Vigang mushroom pasta and tomato pasta (my friend loved Vigan, so he really liked it). And the interior was calm, so I was able to eat comfortably.

You will absolutely love this restaurant!! If you want to have a delicious lunch or dinner with friends, be sure to go!

reviews.author: Glory Hecita
reviews.text: Wow! This place was really pretty! The food was so delicious too! I ordered crab risotto, beef brisket risotto, and spaghetti, and they were all great. The portion was generous and the price was reasonable. I definitely want to come back for pizza next time!

address: 3rd floor, 26 Daehakro 10-gil, Jongno-gu, Seoul, Republic of Korea

reviews.author: Pochon
reviews.text:
Two Find Peter Hyehwa Branch

*Address: 3rd floor, 26 Daehakro 10-gil, Jongno-gu, Seoul

*182m from Exit 2 of Hyehwa Station

*Business hours: 11:00 - 22:00 every day

*Break time: 15:00~16:30 (weekends)

*Final review: The friendly staff spoke appropriately to the chef according to my mother's taste.

I think I found the perfect cream pasta restaurant.

He even called a friend and boasted that there was a good Hyehwa Station restaurant.

I think I will come here often because the portions are generous for the price and the interior is stylish.

Last year, I happened to hear from one of my mom's acquaintances that she doesn't eat greasy food, but she likes cream pasta.

I was quite surprised.

But on this day, he cleared it all in an instant without leaving anything behind.

And people really liked it because it tastes like the most basic carbonara.

I think it suited my mom especially well that the chef cooked it without it being too salty.

Thank you to the friendly chef and staff.

reviews.author: Daehwan Kim
reviews.text:
It's spacious and clean. Order for 10 people at once
I did, and it came out quickly. The portion is not small so you can eat it comfortably.

reviews.author: minnim
reviews.text: The taste was a bit average, but the atmosphere was great! French fries were especially delicious haha.

reviews.author: Kim Tae-heon
reviews.text:
Plenty of food and pretty tasty
And the store is pretty

reviews.author: jin lee
reviews.text:
It was really nice that the space between the seats was wide.
The portions were so large that two women could not eat two menu items.
I think reservations are essential!

reviews.author: Alma Curiosa
reviews.text:
Both pizza and pasta are generous and tasty.
The inside is quite large, but there are a lot of people, so it would be a good idea to make a reservation in advance.
The interior design makes you feel like you’re at a Western-style restaurant🤣! (It seems as if you would take orders face-to-face in a restaurant like this, but unfortunately you order via QR on the table)
Seats that aren't inside seem to be quite noisy.

reviews.author: B K
reviews.text:
Several people visited together during lunch time.
The store is much larger inside than it looks from the outside.
Orders can be placed via QR at your seat.
Although it is a pitjeria, it also sells simple pasta dishes.
The pizza is very well cooked and delicious.
The dough part is also chewy and easy to eat.
The pasta was also delicious. The amount is not small.
There is no wait even during weekday lunch, but there are quite a lot of people.
If you come on the weekend, there may be a wait.
If you want to eat delicious pizza and pasta in Daehakro, this is a place worth considering.

A while later, on my second visit, I ate Carbonara unlike the first, and it was quite delicious, even better than I expected.
The pizza was delicious as expected, and the salad with grilled octopus was also good.

reviews.author: alphabet
reviews.text: I came here because I wanted to eat the famous pizza in Seoul, and I was very satisfied!! I had the Margherita Bufala and the signature Oh! Pizza, and both were very delicious with different feelings!! Both had great flavor and were overall comforting pizzas!! If you come to see a play and are looking for a good restaurant in Daehakro, I definitely recommend this place!! I think I'll be reminded of this every time I come to see a play!! I'll have to try other pizzas next time!!

reviews.author: Jh
reviews.text: I met the pizza of my life at Daehakro pizza restaurant Pizzariao! 🍕 I had the signature Offija and it tasted fresh thanks to the generous amount of arugula! The dough freshly baked from the oven is chewy and flavorful! The combination of fresh tomatoes and cheese is also a work of art! ㅠㅠ The atmosphere of the store was pretty and the staff were friendly, so I had a pleasant meal. If you come to Daehakro, definitely try it. I sincerely recommend it! 💖

reviews.author: Kevin Jung
reviews.text: I went on an outing to Daehakro with my family and chose the Pizzariao salmon pizza and the signature O pizza. The O pizza had wine and the cheese was so delicious and the best. The salmon pizza is also different and delicious. It's the best pizza restaurant with a great atmosphere that makes me want to come back again next time.

reviews.author: Heo Seon-kyung
reviews.text:
It was my first time visiting with my child and it was so delicious!
Because it was the weekend, there were a lot of people so I thought it would take a long time for the food to come out, but it was nice that it came out quickly.
I want to come again next time^^

reviews.author: Hong Kyung-ah
reviews.text: Pitjeriao with children! I like that there are always friendly menu explanations and a variety of menu items. Everything from the salad to the pasta and pizza is delicious, making it a satisfying meal for both mom and dad. The atmosphere is great and it's great to be together on a special day :)
